title: Installation of Barriers at Void Decks and Other Common Spaces
what_it_is: Installation of Barriers at Void Decks and Other Common Spaces

sections.label: Barrier-free access rules for Town Councils
sections.summary: Town Councils must comply with BCA's Code on Accessibility and the Building Control Act, which prohibits obstructing barrier-free access, and the Commissioner may require removal of obstructive barriers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In doing so, they have to comply with the Building and Construction Authority's (BCA) Code on Accessibility in the Built Environment, which sets out the requirements for barrier-free accessibility (BFA) in public spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: When considering whether to install barriers in void decks, walkways and other common property, Town Councils must also abide by the Building Control Act, which stipulates that any barrier-free access must not be obstructed, removed, altered or made unusable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: If barriers are put up such that they unduly obstruct a walkway intended as an accessible route, the Commissioner of Building Control may require the Town Council to remove them.
